content: {"phoneNote":"The opening-hours section is a tall stack of seven brown bars that swallows a whole screen, pushing products and location far down the page.","desktopNote":"The three product cards and the gift-box image leave the right third of the page empty, and the hours grid is an oversized band of bars.","phone":{"impression":3,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":4,"spacing":2,"clutter":3,"distinctiveness":3},"desktop":{"impression":3,"hierarchy":3,"imagery":3,"spacing":2,"clutter":3,"distinctiveness":3},"fixes":["Replace the day-by-day timeline bars with a compact hours table (Mon–Fri 8–19, Sat 8–13, Sun closed) so hours take one small block instead of a full screen.","On desktop fill the product grid (4 columns or wider cards) and let the gift-box image/text pair share the row evenly instead of leaving the right third blank.","Make the location block more useful: add the address and a map or directions button next to the shopfront photo, and reduce the giant footer wordmark."],"blockers":["Desktop, product grid: the 'Pršut in siri' card has no price line while the others do, leaving an uneven row and empty space to the right.","Phone, opening hours: the 'Nedelja' row is cut by the slice edge with 'zaprto' half visible — verify the row renders fully and isn't clipped."]}
